test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 16 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Eight people F, G, N, O, S, T, Y and Z are sitting in a straight line. All of them are facing the North. F sits second from one of the extreme ends of the line. Only three people sit between F and G. N sits second to the right of G. As many people sit to the right of N as to the left of O. Only two people sit between O and S. Y sits at one of the positions to the left of S. T sits at one of the positions to the right of Z.

How many people sit to the left of Z?
solution:
**People facing north** : F, G, N, O, S, T, Y, Z are sitting in a straight line. 

1. F sits second from one of the extreme ends .

**Case 1** :

**Case 1** :

6. Y sits at one of the positions to the left of S. ( Thus, case 2 is eliminated ) 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/960ea25298ada59f775136515345fd4dc034175b455bc3c60261105091356ac8.png] 

7. T sits at one of the positions to the right of Z.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cd9b661e1c3f34c6df79d9f28a300b4aab5ba4dc1eb2241b166039e7d709bb02.png] 

Thus, **4 people** sit to the left of Z . 

Hence, the correct answer is **"4"**.
